title: Step 14 — the initiator reveals the secret and both legs settle
description: Revealing the pre-image on spoke-crc releases the 5,000,000 CRC leg to the settlement agent and publishes the secret. The Cacti relay picks it up and settles the mirror leg on spoke-pen automatically. This single call is what makes the swap atomic.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. Verify the pair yourself: `printf 'd2aec5d19f13a018dd1895ef2f97b1cb0ca95664ff69b99bde9303a7a5dda43c' | xxd -r -p | sha256sum` equals the hash_lock of steps 11 and 12. The secret is hex-decoded before hashing — SHA-256 is taken over the 32 decoded BYTES, not over the ASCII characters, so a non-hex secret is rejected with 400 'invalid secret hex'. There is no API endpoint for the cross-spoke broadcast: a successful call here produces state changes on a gateway you never contacted. The delivered settle path performs NO timelock check of its own; expiry is enforced by the on-chain HTLC, and a rejection there surfaces as 500.
